King Charles Responds to Claims About Princess Diana's Death

Earl Spencer, Princess Diana's brother, has claimed that King Charles III stated "We'll forget her soon enough" after Diana's death. This claim is reportedly made in a new book. Buckingham Palace has issued a rare response, strongly refuting Spencer's allegations. The Palace stated that the claims are "not true" and that they "would not" dignify them with further comment. Other reports indicate Spencer also claimed the King sounded "giddily elated" following Diana's death.
